# Mock Scout — fixture only

Used by verify_asset_prompt.sh to provide SC_MODE / SC_COLOR / SC_AESTHETIC tokens
to asset_prompt.sh during sandboxed tests. Contains generic placeholders so the
emitted prompts are stateless. Not a real scout output — bypasses scout schema.

## Winning visual pattern (native feel)
- mode: mock-photo phone-shot fixture grain — generic test mode token
- color_temperature: neutral natural — generic test color token
- aesthetic: fixture-only test aesthetic — never shipped
